children: Sands China, a majority-owned subsidiary of Las Vegas Sands, completed a $1.0 billion private offering of senior unsecured notes: $700 million of 6.400% notes due 2032 and $300 million of 6.700% notes due 2033. Sands China plans to use the proceeds and cash on hand to redeem its $700 million of 2.300% notes due 2027, repay borrowings under its revolving credit facility and fund general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures.
: Private offering of senior unsecured notes
: Professional investors and qualified institutional buyers
: Refinance debt, repay revolving facility borrowings and fund capital expenditures
